```{r}
data <- read.csv("data/students.csv")
summary(data)
```


```{r}
## imput tidyverse formule
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
data %>% ## add table 
  summarise_if(is.numeric, list( ##numeric
    mean = mean,
    sd = sd,
    median = median,
    quantile = quantile,
    min = min,
    max = max
  ), na.rm = TRUE) ## skip the missing values
## the summary is different from one column to the next because the column with not the same type don't have the same summary 
```
